description: This file is a shell script that sets up environment variables, functions, and configurations for working with git repositories. It includes helper functions for error handling, path fixing, repository validation, and other git-related operations. The script is intended to be sourced by other shell scripts to establish a consistent environment for git commands.

methods.name: git_broken_path_fix
methods.description: Fixes the PATH environment variable to include a specified directory, avoiding broken paths in the environment.

methods.name: die
methods.description: Outputs an error message and exits the script with status 1.

methods.name: die_with_status
methods.description: Outputs an error message and exits the script with a specified status code.

methods.name: set_reflog_action
methods.description: Sets the GIT_REFLOG_ACTION environment variable to record the current operation in git reflog.

methods.name: git_editor
methods.description: Invokes the configured git text editor.

methods.name: git_pager
methods.description: Invokes the configured git pager for output.

methods.name: is_bare_repository
methods.description: Checks if the current directory is a bare git repository.

methods.name: cd_to_toplevel
methods.description: Changes directory to the top-level of the current git working tree.

methods.name: require_work_tree_exists
methods.description: Ensures that the current git repository has a working tree.

methods.name: require_work_tree
methods.description: Verifies that the current directory is inside a git working tree.

methods.name: require_clean_work_tree
methods.description: Checks that the working tree is clean (no unstaged or uncommitted changes).

methods.name: pick_ident_script
methods.description: Creates a sed script for parsing identities such as author and committer from commit data.

methods.name: parse_ident_from_commit
methods.description: Uses sed to parse commit identity fields based on a script generated by pick_ident_script.

methods.name: get_author_ident_from_commit
methods.description: Extracts author identity information from a commit object.

methods.name: create_virtual_base
methods.description: Creates a virtual base for a three-way merge by identifying common lines between two files.

methods.name: git_dir_init
methods.description: Initializes variables to validate and set the git directory, ensuring the script runs inside a valid git repository.

methods.name: peel_committish
methods.description: Converts a possibly symbolic reference into an absolute commit hash.
